meta.source: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance (1987-present), domestic scheduled flights

definitions.cd: cancelled or diverted: you need a different flight
definitions.sop: flight operated and arrived more than x minutes after its scheduled arrival
definitions.trouble: cancelled, diverted, or arrived 60+ minutes late (used to estimate airport and route factors)
definitions.rec: if cancelled: hours later you would arrive taking the second later operated flight on the same airline and route
